claim_not_supported: That axes 7-12, engine nodes, or any runtime field-of-engines ontology is octonionic, Albert, or E-series; axes 7-12 remain a planned non-runtime mirror layer.
That the 8-real projection of Choi deviations is natural, canonical, unique, or physically derived rather than an imposed packing hypothesis.
That n=3 is 'the first valid triadic engine-field Albert carrier candidate' in any dynamical, state-space, or runtime sense.

That Jordan failure at n=4 specifically kills 'dimension 52 is not F4-as-state-space'; dim H_4(O)=52 equals dim F_4 only as numerology, F_4 = Aut(H_3(O)), and the relevant representation is the 26-dimensional traceless Albert algebra, not H_4(O).
Any derivation or proof of octonion structure constants, Albert product, or exceptional series from channel counts, overlaps, or Choi data alone.
That numerical pass/fail of the Jordan identity on channel-derived numbers constitutes evidence the channels 'realize' or 'know' octonions; for generic entries the pattern is purely algebraic.
Promotion of the construction to active runtime truth or activation of axes 7-12.
claim_supported: Numerical check that matrices assembled as H_n(O) (real diagonal + octonion off-diagonals via Fano structure constants) satisfy the Jordan identity for n=2 and n=3 and violate it for n=4 on generic entries, matching the classical theorem that the only octonionic Hermitian Jordan algebras are H_2(O) and the Albert algebra H_3(O).
Dimensional accounting: dim H_n(O) = n + 8*C(n,2) gives 10 (n=2), 27 (n=3), 52 (n=4), so the packing is dimensionally consistent with known objects.
A fixed a-priori map from pairwise Choi deviations into 8 real edge coordinates can populate candidate H_n(O) objects without immediate formal contradiction for n<=3.
Negative controls on the multiplication table and edge algebra can falsify the necessity of the specific octonion structure constants and the selective n<=3 Jordan pattern.
Independent verification that input objects remain valid Choi operators of qubit channels (positivity, partial-trace conditions).
implementation_warnings: The step 'project pairwise Choi deviations into 8 real relation features' is critically underspecified. Freeze a deterministic, parameter-free map (e.g. fixed linear projections or HS pairings against a declared 8-frame) before any run; never fit or select the map to make Jordan pass. Acknowledge that a qubit Choi deviation is far higher-dimensional than 8, so the map is lossy.

Clarify the generative model: what is a 'channel for an engine node' versus a pairwise object? One local channel per node plus derived pairwise deviations, or explicit bipartite channels? Document it.

Implement the Jordan product exactly as X ∘ Y = (X*Y + Y*X)/2 with nonassociative octonion matrix multiplication, force real diagonals and conjugate symmetry of off-diagonals, and test the Jordan identity on many random triples with an explicit numerical tolerance. Because the result is algebraic, generic n=3 success + n=4 failure mainly validates the multiplication table and assembly code; failure on generic n=3 data means a bug.
H_2(O) (dim 10) is a positive control that must pass; do not omit it.
Floating-point nonassociativity requires double precision, exact integer structure constants (Fano signs), and statistical aggregation; do not treat a single matrix triple as decisive.
Do not equate dim 52 with F_4 state space or claim the n=4 failure 'kills F4'; keep language strictly to the Jordan identity of H_n(O).
Keep all interpretive language demoted: success only licenses 'formal packing is consistent with classical H_3(O) vs H_4(O) facts'. Axes 7-12 stay non-runtime.

If the chosen 8-feature map is arbitrary or produces highly non-generic (low-rank, commuting, associative) edges, the entire sim is only illustrative and cannot be used even as a weak consistency check.
mandatory_controls: Shuffled/random structure constants (non-Fano): must destroy selective Jordan success at n=3.
Sedenion (or other non-division) edge multiplication: must fail Jordan already at n=3 or introduce zero-divisor pathologies.
Quaternionic edges (associative): H_n(H) must satisfy Jordan for n=2,3,4, isolating nonassociativity as the n=4 killer.
Complex and real edges: Jordan must continue to hold at n=4.
Componentwise, matrix-algebra, or other non-octonion products on the same 8-vectors: must not reproduce the n=2,3-pass / n=4-fail pattern.
Identical channels, zero-deviation (decoupled) edges, or constant features: structure must collapse to trivial/diagonal cases where Jordan holds only degenerately; require generic ensembles.
Unit tests of the Fano multiplication table itself (e_i^2 = -1, anticommutativity, Fano lines, alternativity/Moufang identities, non-vanishing associators) before any H_n construction.
Choi positivity, complete positivity, and trace-preservation (or unitality) checks on every generated channel.
Ensemble statistics over many random CPTP maps and many random triples inside each H_n(O): report pass fractions, not single examples.
Left-multiplication 8x8 real matrix representation control to contrast associative matrix algebra against genuine nonassociative octonion product.
response.notes_for_codex: Treat this as a pure bounded scratch diagnostic and kill-test inside Codex-Ratchet, not theory confirmation. Hard-code and unit-test the Fano structure constants first. Make Choi-to-8-features a pure documented function with zero free parameters. Generate ensembles of random qubit CPTP maps (Ginibre/Kraus) and also pure random H_n(O) entries so the algebraic fact is separated from channel specialness. Explicitly log dims 10/27/52. On PASS the only allowed promoted sentence is: 'bounded numerical check confirms octonion-Hermitian packing of 8-edge features reproduces classical Jordan success for n=2,3 and failure for n=4; necessary but far from sufficient for any engine-field Albert reading; axes 7-12 remain planned non-runtime mirror layer.' Kill stronger ontology language. Previous pressure stands: counts and dimensions alone never prove O/Albert/E-series; this sim at best supplies one explicit packing map plus kill controls. If the projection map cannot be made non-arbitrary, demote the whole exercise to illustrative and do not ratchet any claim forward.
response.pass_rule: Diagnostic PASSES if and only if: (1) frozen Fano structure constants + generic channel-derived or random edge coordinates yield Jordan identity holding within tolerance for H_2(O) and H_3(O) on the large majority of sampled triples and clearly failing for H_4(O); (2) every mandatory negative control breaks that selective pattern in the predicted direction (shuffled/sedenion fail n=3, quaternion/complex/real pass n=4, degenerate edges only trivial success, etc.); (3) all input Choi operators pass positivity and channel constraints; (4) the 8-feature map is declared and frozen a priori with no post-hoc adjustment; (5) structure-constant unit tests pass. Any clause failure = overall FAIL. A PASS authorizes solely the weak statement that the octonion-Hermitian packing of 8-feature data reproduces the classical Albert / non-Albert pattern; it does not authorize Albert-carrier, F4-state-space, or axes-7-12 runtime claims.
